mapping_json.fidelity_notes: COMPOSITE melee->projectile STRIKE (b04 frost-blades precedent: one source skill = two engine geometries, melee leads per s7.2). The FORWARD ~85-degree fan (vs frost-blades' behind-target fan) is the directional signature; multi_projectile carries the fan, direction noted. 50% phys->lightning -> ELEMENT_CONVERSION_PHYSICAL (partial-conversion attack, b04 ice-shot/molten-class routing); GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade routes the hit-spawns-projectiles propagation identity (b04 frost-blades exact precedent). PoE shock -> sunder on both components. Eras 1.x;3.20+ CONFIRMED (introduced 0.9.6; 3.20 reduced projectile count -- the 3-base count mapped is the modern verified number). The cannot-miss-if-melee-connects guarantee and the 50%-less fan damage are behavioral/numeric riders with no carriers (noted).
